description: This Java class implements the TbCoreToTransportService interface, providing methods to process and send transport messages via a message queue, including handling success and failure callbacks.

classes.name: DefaultTbCoreToTransportService
classes.description: Implements message processing for transport layer, sending messages to a queue with success and failure callbacks.

classes.name: QueueCallbackAdaptor
classes.description: Handles callback actions upon message send success or failure.

methods.name: DefaultTbCoreToTransportService
methods.description: Constructor initializing topic service and message producer.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Sends a transport message to a topic, with optional success and failure callbacks.

methods.name: onSuccess
methods.description: Callback invoked upon successful message enqueue.

methods.name: onFailure
methods.description: Callback invoked upon failure to enqueue message.
